page.notes: Printed lines in the middle of the page are Greek annotations with several doubtful letters (e.g. the Theophrastus lemma and the accent-marked infinitives); those readings are best-effort. The "<" mark before the italic note line is treated as a note marker, not text. The short italic note line was placed as a left-side note; its position may be a column line instead. "collectam" is read from a cut-off word at the line end. The catchword "graues" is the first word of the next page, set at the lower right.
